name: creative-clippath
title: Creative Squiggle Clip Path
description: A three-column strip where each media item is cut out with a hand-drawn squiggly silhouette: a red-toned camera portrait, a broccoli clip on deep blue, and a pale tower-and-camera shot.
use: A portfolio or brand page wants a playful break from rectangular image grids.
avoid: The demo pulls photos and a video from external URLs, and the crop can cut off subjects at small sizes.
a11y: Both photos use the alt text 'Description', the video has no label or captions, and the autoplay loop ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three tall media panels sit side by side on a white card. Each is clipped to a different lumpy, scalloped outline rather than a rectangle: left a red-toned photo of hands and a vintage camera, middle a bright broccoli head on deep blue, right a pale sepia building scene with a camera.
behaves: The middle panel is a looping video whose leaves shimmer slightly. Pointing at any panel scales its content up a little within the fixed cut-out silhouette, so the picture grows but the shape stays put.
customise: The three media URLs, their clip-path definitions and alt text are hardcoded; swapping images means editing the file and matching each figure to a shape id.
weight: moderate: Two images plus an always-playing background video; light DOM but decoding video costs.
